syscalls.comment: TIOCGPTPEER (Linux 4.13) fails with ENOTTY, as on a kernel without it: the start opens the slave by its path.
clone with CLONE_PIDFD (Linux 5.2) fails with EINVAL: the start runs clone again without the flag.
waitid with P_PIDFD (Linux 5.4) fails with EINVAL: children are reaped by pid.

pidfd_send_signal (5.1), pidfd_open (5.3), clone3 (5.3), and close_range (5.9) fail with ENOSYS: no pidfd, so children are signaled with kill after a check, and the child marks descriptors close-on-exec one by one.
